title: OA TABLE 71 - the yearly events: the nineteen events of the percentile die with their contiguous ranges 1-100
audit_comment: OA round eighty-four (capture p. 237): Table 71 - the yearly events grid, the nineteen events across the percentile die with the contiguous ranges, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA TABLE 71, printed capture p. 237 - the yearly events round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift. THE GRID: the nineteen yearly events across the percentile die, the ranges contiguous and complete - Ambassador 1-10; Assassination of a Lord 11-15; Birth 16-30; Comet the lone 31; Death of a Lord 32-40; Earthquake Major 41-43; Famine 44-47; Fire Major 48-52; Flood 53-57; Incursion Major the lone 58; Marriage 59-68; New Religion the lone 69; Plague 70-74; Political Plot 75-78; Rebellion 79-85; Tsunami the lone 86; Visitation the lone 87; Volcano the lone 88; War the 89-100 - the widest range, war the likeliest of the year. THE USE: the yearly event determined FIRST, one only in a given year, remaining in effect for the entire year and often determining the type of the monthly events; the occurrence month the 1d12 roll; the scope the campaign area alone, or one event per land when the player characters travel or spread. The grid codifies per the R431 calculus

consts.comment: the Table 71 event count - the nineteen yearly events across the percentile die, the loop bound of the emitted grid audit (print capture p. 237)

consts.name: djkOA71WarMin
consts.comment: the War range minimum - the 89 of the 89-100, the widest range of the table, war the likeliest yearly event (print capture p. 237)

consts.name: djkOA71WarMax
consts.comment: the War range maximum - the 100 of the 89-100 (print capture p. 237)

bools.name: djkOA71OnePerYear
bools.comment: the yearly event rule - only one yearly event in a given year, determined first and remaining in effect for the entire year, often determining the type of monthly events that occur (print capture p. 237)

bools.name: djkOA71Month1d12
bools.comment: the occurrence month - once the yearly event is known, 1d12 rolled to find the month it occurs in or begins (print capture p. 237)

bools.name: djkOA71CampaignAreaOnly
bools.comment: the scope - yearly events normally figured only for the campaign area, but a traveling group or several groups meaning one yearly event per land of involvement (the Kozakura and Shou Lung example) (print capture p. 237)
